name: Bloodborne bbport
summary: bbport Linux AppImage with your extracted CUSA00900 game and 1.09 update, portable data paths and the NVIDIA libcuda startup fix.

release_rules.notes: Numbered stable releases with a single Bloodborne-bbport-x86_64.AppImage. Pre-releases such as 0.5-pre4 are ignored.

pkgtool.description: LibOrbisPkg PkgTool 0.2.231 for Linux, used only to extract your PKG files.

inputs.label: Bloodborne (USA) CUSA00900 base game PKG
inputs.notes: Checked after extraction: title CUSA00900, version 01.09 with the update, and an accepted eboot.bin hash.

inputs.label: Previously extracted game folder (optional)
inputs.notes: A folder under the app data prepared/ directory that already contains the extracted game. It is used only when it passes the same title, version and eboot.bin checks.

operations.name: bbport_nvidia_libraries
operations.description: Expose matching host libcuda libraries to bbport's portable NVIDIA cache (upstream issue #135); does nothing without a matching NVIDIA driver and respects explicit Vulkan overrides

operations.text:
Bloodborne bbport {version} portable test package with your CUSA00900 game and 1.09 update.
Extract the entire ZIP to a writable folder, then run ./Launch.sh (or ./Launch.sh --play to skip the launcher). Linux needs Python 3 and a Vulkan 1.3 driver.
Saves, settings, mods and generated files stay in data/. Move the complete folder together.
On NVIDIA the launcher links the matching host libcuda libraries into data/vulkan/nvidia at every start (upstream issue #135). Driver libraries are not bundled; explicit VK_DRIVER_FILES or VK_ICD_FILENAMES overrides are respected. For fallback use BB_DLSS=0 ./Launch.sh --play.
Official upstream: https://github.com/{repository}
Experimental: gameplay is not confirmed.

linux.instructions: Extract the whole ZIP to a writable folder and run ./Launch.sh, or ./Launch.sh --play to skip bbport's launcher. Requires Python 3 for the path and NVIDIA helpers.

saves: Launch.sh points XDG and BB_* directories at data/ inside the package. portable-paths.py rewrites the launcher's settings whenever the folder moves.
limitations: Experimental. Gameplay has not been confirmed on any platform.
No separate DLC entitlement is added.
Each package is about 30 GB and is stored uncompressed.
Linux startup (not gameplay) was checked on Fedora 44 / RTX 5090 / NVIDIA 595.58.03 with the NVIDIA fix. Other GPUs and the Steam Deck are untested.
Upstream issue #135 is still open for 0.51; the launcher workaround remains necessary. Re-check it when a newer bbport release appears.

verified_releases.evidence: Revision nvidiafix1 (SHA-256 7dbc3bcd…72b8) started on Fedora 44 / RTX 5090; gameplay not confirmed (RomM 12971).

history: 2026-10-11: PKGs extracted by hand with PkgTool in a container, packaged with outputs/package-bloodborne.py, then repackaged with the NVIDIA helper (repackage-bloodborne-fixed.py). This definition automates the same steps.
